'''Boost attribute''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell was similar to the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] [[Enhance Attribute]]. When used, the Ascendant increased their skill in a certain area, allowing them jump higher or shoot better. When activated, the Ascendant was wreathed in a bright, flame-like visual aura. Depending on the particular attribute being boosted, the aura could be one of several colors and behaved differently.
